definitions.source_regression: 1 if received source timestamp is <= previous received source timestamp for same run
definitions.sequence_regression: 1 if signed modulo-4096 sequence difference <= 0; wraparound supported
definitions.duplicate_payload: 1 if source timestamp, sequence, and payload ID equal any of previous 30 delivered packets
definitions.packet_age_s: arrival minus source time, synchronized simulation clock only; unavailable on unsynchronized real clocks
definitions.arrival_delta_s: arrival time since previous delivered packet
definitions.received_rate_pps: delivered background and telemetry packet count per sampling interval divided by interval
definitions.sequence_gap: positive modulo-4096 sequence difference minus one, capped at 100; resets on regression
definitions.ap_changed: 1 when received modeled AP identity differs from previous received identity
definitions.association_duration_s: elapsed arrival time since the most recent received AP identity change; computed from delivered packets only, retained across temporal gaps, and reset on run change
definitions.noninitial_association_duration_s: elapsed arrival time since the current received AP first differed from the run initial AP; the initial AP and association state persist across packet gaps, while rolling temporal windows reset; zero when the received AP matches the initial AP; raw AP identities are never model inputs
definitions.packet_age_excess_s: current synchronized packet age minus the median packet age of the first 10 delivered observations after run initialization or a temporal gap reset; baseline is frozen after warm-up and uses no labels
definitions.association_latency_excess_s: current synchronized packet age minus the median of up to the 10 most recent delivered packet ages immediately before the latest received AP transition; reference is frozen for that association and retained across packet gaps until the next observed AP transition or run reset
definitions.management_frame: 1 if the delivered modeled frame is a management/reassociation frame; benign roaming can also emit these
definitions.vertical_residual_m: absolute altitude change minus upward velocity times positive source-time delta, on delivered telemetry; zero when unavailable
